abstract.p: We study long-term memory retrieval for embodied agents, combining recency, importance and relevance scoring in a unified framework.

div.head: Introduction
div.p: Embodied agents need persistent memory across play sessions to behave consistently toward the player.

div.head: Related Work
div.p: Earlier systems relied on fixed dialogue trees without any retrieval component.

div.head: Method
